item.title: トランプ氏、ベセント財務長官のＡＩ責任者起用を否定
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）分野を担当する新組織「ＡＩフォース」の責任者にベセント財務長官を起用しない方針を示した。

トランプ氏は「ベセント氏がスーパーインテリジェンス（ＳＩ）ツァーに就任することはない。本人もそれを望んでおらず、財務省で素晴らしい仕事をしている。その職にとどまってほしい」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

トランプ氏は１９日、「ＡＩフォース」を創設し、米政府のＡＩ政策を統括する「ＡＩツァー（ＡＩ皇帝）」を任命すると表明。ホワイトハウスは政府のＡＩ政策責任者に誰が起用される可能性があるか、現時点で明らかにしていない。

item.title: Corporate debt maturities set to test US borrowers as rates rise
item.description: A growing wall of US corporate debt is set to mature from 2027, putting pressure on companies to refinance borrowings raised at ultra-low interest rates during the pandemic.
item.dc:creator: Patturaja Murugaboopathy
item.content:encoded: A growing wall of US corporate debt is set to mature from 2027, putting pressure on companies to refinance borrowings raised at ultra-low interest rates during the pandemic. About $4.3 trillion of non-financial corporate bonds issued in US markets will mature between 2027 and 2031, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data showed. Annual maturities rise from about $572 billion in 2027 to roughly $1.03 trillion in 2030, after many companies pushed debt into later years through refinancing. The challenge comes as global debt has climbed above a record $365 trillion, according to the Institute of International Finance, while higher Treasury yields have lifted refinancing costs across markets. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield is above 5%, around its highest level since 2007. As the debt comes due, companies that locked in cheap fixed-rate funding earlier in the decade will increasingly have to refinance at higher costs, pressuring earnings and cash flow. The burden will be heaviest for lower-rated borrowers. High-yield bond maturities jump from about $68.5 billion in 2027 to $314.1 billion in 2029, according to LSEG, while investment-grade maturities increase to $512.6 billion from $437 billion. High-yield debt will account for about a third of all maturities in 2029, up from 12% in 2027. Bond fund manager PIMCO said most investment-grade and high-yield issuers should be able to absorb higher refinancing costs, but the weakest borrowers face a sharper squeeze. Coupons on CCC-rated bonds due in 2027 and 2028 could roughly double if refinanced at current index yields, it said. The refinancing wave will coincide with heavy borrowing by major technology companies to fund artificial intelligence infrastructure. Goldman Sachs expects gross debt issuance by hyperscalers including Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle to reach $420 billion in 2027, up 60% from estimated 2026 levels.

item.title: ロシアでの拘束、周到な「おとり捜査」 米ＷＳＪ記者が著書で見解
item.description:
Mark Trevelyan
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mark Trevelyan

[ロンドン　２５日　ロイター] - ２０２３年にロシアで拘束後、スパイ罪に問われ収監されていた米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）のエバン・ゲルシコビッチ記者が、一連の経緯を詳細に記した著書で、自身の拘束がロシア連邦保安庁（ＦＳＢ）による周到な「おとり捜査」によるものだったとの見解を示した。ＷＳＪが２５日、著書の抜粋を報じた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は、ロシアの軍需生産を巡り、防衛産業の拠点エカテリンブルクの工場の労働組合関係者に２回、対面で取材した。２度目にレストランで会った際、戦車の生産に関するものだとする手書きの書類を見せられ、メモを取っていると、近づいてきた覆面の男らに拘束されたという。

ゲルシコビッチ記者や編集者らは事前に取材のリスクを検討。情報提供者が書類を持ち込まないようにすることや、持ち込まれた場合にも受け取らないことを決めていた。ただ、２回目の対面取材では「書類が手に押し付けられた」とし、これらの２回の対面取材は、ＦＳＢがロシアのプーチン大統領に対し、スパイだと説得し、拘束する承認を得るためだったとの見方を示した。

プーチン氏は２４年２月、米テレビのインタビューで、ゲルシコビッチ記者が機密情報を収集している最中に現行犯逮捕されたとの認識を示していた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は懲役１６年の判決を受けたが、２４年８月の囚人交換で釈放された。記者やＷＳＪ、米政府は、いずれも記者がスパイだったことを否定している。

item.title: Rendimientos de bonos del Tesoro siguen subiendo tras positivos datos económicos en EEUU
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos de más largo plazo subieron el viernes, prolongando la reciente tendencia alcista, tras unos positivos datos económicos que reforzaban las crecientes preocupaciones sobre la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Caroline Valetkevitch
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos de más largo plazo subieron el viernes, prolongando la reciente tendencia alcista, tras unos positivos datos económicos que reforzaban las crecientes preocupaciones sobre la inflación. El retorno de las notas a 30 años tocó un nuevo pico de 22 años, mientras que el de la deuda referencial a 10 años alcanzó su cota más alta en 19 años. Los rendimientos se han disparado recientemente debido a la persistente preocupación por la acelaración de la inflación. Los nuevos pedidos de bienes de capital manufacturados clave en Estados Unidos aumentaron más de lo esperado en agosto y las cifras del mes anterior se revisaron al alza, en lo que ha sido otro trimestre de sólido crecimiento del gasto empresarial en equipamiento en el contexto del auge de la inteligencia artificial. El informe se sumó a una encuesta de S&P Global que mostró esta semana un repunte de la actividad empresarial en septiembre. El rendimiento de los bonos referenciales a 10 años ganó 0,3 puntos básicos, al 5,165%, tras haber alcanzado el 5,2297%, su nivel más alto desde 2007. El retorno de los papeles a 30 años subía 2,4 puntos básicos, al 5,4686%, luego de empinarse al 5,2297%, su nivel más alto desde 2007. Las expectativas de una nueva subida de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal aumentaron esta semana tras los datos alcistas. Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME Group, los operadores ven una probabilidad superior al 64% de otra alza cuando el banco central estadounidense se reúna de nuevo en octubre. Un indicador muy seguido de la curva de rendimiento, que mide la diferencia entre el retorno de las notas a dos y 10 años y es considerada una medida de las expectativas económicas, operaba en 30,3 puntos básicos. El rendimiento de la deuda a dos años , que suele evolucionar en paralelo a las expectativas sobre las tasas de la Fed, bajó 3,5 puntos básicos, al 4,86%.

item.title: Alcaraz helps Team Europe take 3-1 Laver Cup lead over Team World
item.description: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over defending champions Team World on the opening day of the Laver Cup on Friday, with Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik closing out the night with a straight sets doubles victory at The O2.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Team Europe took a 3-1 lead over defending champions Team World on the opening day of the Laver Cup on Friday, with Carlos Alcaraz and Jakub Mensik closing out the night with a straight sets doubles victory at The O2. World No. 3 Alcaraz, competing in his second tournament after the US Open following a four-month injury layoff, joined Mensik to beat Alexander Bublik and Taylor Fritz 6-4 6-4. The Spaniard and Czech, who also partnered at last year's Laver Cup in San Francisco, fended off three early break points before Alcaraz found his range and fired an overhead smash to secure the first break. They broke again early in the second set and held firm from there, with Mensik serving out the match, with Alcaraz sealing victory at the net. "I'm just trying to have fun in every place that I go and on every court that I play on," Alcaraz said. "I don't usually play doubles ... I just try to enjoy and be better at things. I use doubles to try and improve my tennis, a couple of adjustments. Having a partner like Jakub, it's really easy to have fun on the court." The victory gave Europe three points from Friday's four matches, after Norwegian Casper Ruud got them off to a winning start by edging Francisco Cerundolo 6-7(4) 6-4 10-8. Brandon Nakashima levelled the contest for Team World by beating Mensik 6-1 3-6 10-7, before Rafael Jodar restored Europe's lead with a commanding 6-2 6-3 victory over Alexander Bublik in the Spaniard's Laver Cup debut. Jodar, who was watched from the stands by Roger Federer and John McEnroe, said he was thrilled to have the tennis greats at his first appearance in the competition. "It's a pleasure that they are in the stands watching me," Jodar said. "It's a pleasure to see them watching these types of matches." OPENING STRIKES Earlier on Friday, Ruud and Cerundolo were locked in a tight opening set, with neither player able to break before the Argentine edged the tiebreak 7-4. Ruud responded by breaking for a 5-4 lead in the second set which he claimed before forcing the match tiebreak, where the Norwegian held his nerve after the players traded points until 8-8. "I have to thank my team and my bench. They pushed me all the way. They kept me in it, really ... Europe can build on this," Ruud said. Nakashima then produced a composed performance on his Laver Cup debut, racing to a 5-0 lead against Mensik before the Czech fought back to take the second set, leaving the American to wrap up victory in the match tiebreak. "This guy... I'm not convinced he's real. I think he's AI," Team World captain Andre Agassi said, praising Nakashima's ability to stay calm under pressure. "He just goes about his business point after point after point." The three-day Laver Cup pits six players from Europe against six from the rest of the world, with victories worth one point on Friday, two on Saturday and three on Sunday. The first team to reach 13 points wins the title.

item.title: Subway, soccer and spats: New York's Mamdani a UN week attraction
item.description: The United Nations wasn't the only New York attraction for visiting world leaders this week – Mayor Zohran Mamdani emerged as a popular draw for like-minded politicians and a target for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Nichols
item.content:encoded: The United Nations wasn't the only New York attraction for visiting world leaders this week – Mayor Zohran Mamdani emerged as a popular draw for like-minded politicians and a [USN:L8N45F07N TEXT:"target"] for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The 34-year-old former state lawmaker, who took office on January 1 in New York City, rode the subway with Ireland's Prime Minister Micheal Martin, exchanged soccer jerseys with [USN:L8N45D1RH TEXT:"Brazilian President"] Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, and talked to students with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store about artificial intelligence. "In a year when the main sentiment around the UN is existential gloom about the state of the world, a perky young politico was what we all needed," said Richard Gowan, director of global issues and institutions at the International Crisis Group. "Of course a meeting with Mamdani is pretty politically low-risk for most leaders. You spend some time on the subway and with school kids. Nobody is going to ask you to solve the North Korea nuclear problem," he added. The New York mayor was also a focus of Netanyahu's Thursday address to the 193-member UN General Assembly in which he berated Mamdani for calling him a war criminal over Israel's actions in Gaza. Mamdani discussed "Building an Economy for the Many” over breakfast with Spain's President Pedro Sánchez, Barbados Prime Minister Mia Mottley and European Council President António Costa, and met LGBTQ+ youth with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten. Costa, a former mayor of Lisbon, told Mamdani at the event on Tuesday: "You have the best job that a politician can do – I miss the ability mayors sometimes have of identifying a problem in the morning and having it solved by the end of the day." Austrian President Alexander Van der Bellen and British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband also had meetings with Mamdani. WAR OF WORDS WITH NETANYAHU While Democrat Mamdani's meetings were largely with world leaders of similar political leanings, there was one notable exception: Republican US President Donald Trump. As Trump's ally Netanyahu escalated a war of words with New York's first Muslim mayor, Trump met with Mamdani at Gracie Mansion, the mayor's official residence. "I want him to be a great mayor, and he's certainly got potential, got great potential," Trump said at a joint press conference with Mamdani after their meeting on Monday. Netanyahu's address on Thursday was a stark contrast. "You tried to stop me from coming here. You tried. You tried to silence me. Well, you can't silence me. You can't silence the truth," Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader, said of Mamdani. Mamdani campaigned for office on a promise to have Netanyahu arrested for alleged war crimes should he visit the largest US city, but later said he determined he lacked the legal authority to do so. This week, Mamdani described Netanyahu as "the architect of a horrific genocide against Palestinians." The evening before Netanyahu's arrival, Mamdani posted a video on social media of him planting an olive tree at Gracie Mansion with Palestinian families from Gaza with the caption: "May peace be our future." Making his first visit to New York on Thursday since Mamdani took office, Netanyahu told the General Assembly: "Israel didn't commit genocide. Israel prevented genocide." In response, Mamdani accused Netanyahu of using his UN speech "to repeat baseless lies meant to sanitize his genocide of Palestinians," adding: "Yet no lie can change the fact that he remains the subject of an International Criminal Court arrest warrant alleging war crimes and crimes against humanity.” Israel rejects genocide allegations and says its military campaign targets Hamas, not Gaza’s civilian population. It says it takes steps to minimize civilian harm and says Hamas fighters embed among civilians.

item.title: Meta misled users about Facebook data practices, New Mexico jury finds
item.description: A jury in Santa Fe, New Mexico, found on Friday that Meta Platforms misled the state's residents in a case arising from allegations that a political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: A jury in Santa Fe, New Mexico, found on Friday that Meta Platforms (META.O) misled the state's residents in a case arising from allegations that a political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent. The verdict followed a two-week trial over a lawsuit filed by New Mexico’s attorney general in 2021, three years after news reports revealed that the firm, Cambridge Analytica, had harvested personal data from as many as 87 million Facebook users through a third-party app. A Meta spokesperson said the company disagreed with the verdict and would continue to defend itself "against efforts to distort our record." "Meta's platforms are forums for free expression," the spokesperson said. "We have a First Amendment right to manage those platforms in a way we believe best serves the interests of our community. This means prioritizing free speech, protecting our users' information and giving them control over their data." At a press conference after the verdict was announced, New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez said the case revealed "in stark detail the way in which this company plays fast and loose with the rules." The state accused Meta of misleading New Mexicans about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation. New Mexico argued that Facebook failed to disclose that it sold user data to outside parties and allowed harmful content to spread when doing so benefited the company's bottom line. Jurors found 26 of 29 statements identified by the state were misleading, including comments about user data, hate speech and misinformation. They rejected claims that Meta misled consumers in statements about its efforts to remove harmful content and its fact-checking practices. MAXIMUM PENALTY SOUGHT Judge Francis Mathew will now determine civil penalties after jurors found more than 43 million violations, based on the number of people affected by the company's misleading statements. Under New Mexico law, Mathew can award up to $5,000 per violation. Torrez said his office is evaluating how much to seek but will push for the maximum penalty based on the jury's findings. The state will also ask Mathew to direct Meta to make changes, which could include corrections to its past misstatements as well as an audit of the way it manages user data, Torrez said. MISLEADING CLAIMS DETAILED The state's lawsuit focused on specific statements, including comments made by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg or in company blog posts, that New Mexico said made people believe they had control over the personal information they shared on the site, or that the site had blanket policies for how it dealt with hate speech or misinformation. Meta was selling the data to third-party apps, like the one that Cambridge Analytica relied on, and had exceptions to its policies for certain users, the state said. Attorneys for Meta had argued at trial that the allegedly misleading statements were cherry-picked snippets that ignored critical context from the same statements, in which the company had repeatedly acknowledged its handling of misinformation or privacy issues was not perfect. Meta also denied that it sells users' information. Reuters viewed the trial on Courtroom View Network. EARLIER NEW MEXICO CASE The verdict marks the second time in six months a jury in Santa Fe has weighed a lawsuit brought by the state of New Mexico against Meta Platforms. In the first trial, which ended in March, a Santa Fe jury found Meta misled users about young users’ safety on its Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp platforms and ordered the company [USN:L6N40B0XV TEXT:"to pay $375 million"] in civil penalties. After a second phase of that trial, a judge directed the company to [USN:L6N4431IA TEXT:"pay $567 million"] into a New Mexico fund for teen mental health and ordered Meta to implement measures to protect teen Facebook and Instagram users in New Mexico. A few weeks after the judge’s ruling, Meta reached [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"a sweeping settlement"] with 47 US states, Washington, D.C., and US territories, agreeing to pay a maximum of about $16.7 billion to resolve claims that it designed Facebook and Instagram to addict young children. As part of that deal, it agreed to pay a handful of states that had sued the company over privacy violations related to Cambridge Analytica $459 million to resolve those cases. New Mexico was not part of the settlement, so its case over Cambridge Analytica moved forward to trial.

item.title: ゲイツ氏が警告、AIは「10億人の死」を引き起こせるほど強力
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米マイクロソフトの共同創業者ビル・ゲイツ氏は、AIは多くの人類を死に至らせるほど強力なツールだと警告した。AIがもたらす存亡上のリスクに警鐘を鳴らすテクノロジー業界の経営者らが増える中、ゲイツ氏もこうした声に加わった。

ゲイツ氏は、今週末に放送予定の米NBCのインタビューで、「AIには、10億人を死に至らせるような事態を引き起こすだけの力が確かにある」と述べた。インタビューの抜粋によれば同氏は、「悪意を持つ人間が最新のAIツールを使うという組み合わせほど強力な武器は、これまで存在しなかった」と語った。

シリコンバレーでは、AI技術が急速に進歩する中、壊滅的な被害が生じる可能性への警告が強まっている。アンソロピックの従業員だったジェイコブ・コクソン氏は今月同社を退社し、アンソロピックとOpenAIの両社に対し、「超知能に向かって突き進み、人命を危険にさらす賭けに出ている」と批判した。また、アンソロピックの別の従業員は、今後10年以内にAIが全人類を滅ぼす確率は10％を超えると考えていると述べた。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）はAI開発のペースを落とすよう訴えており、この主張にはオープンAIのサム・アルトマンCEOやイーロン・マスク氏ら同業者が支持を表明した。

ゲイツ氏はインタビューで、自主規制だけでは不十分だと指摘。「どのような安全対策や監視体制が必要なのかを巡る議論に、法執行機関や政治家が加わる必要がある」と述べ、「そして、それは義務付けられなければならない」と語った。

原題：Bill Gates Says AI Powerful Enough to Lead to ‘a Billion Deaths’

By Bo Erickson, Susan Heavey and Katharine Jackson WASHINGTON, Sept 25 (Reuters) – US President Donald Trump said on Friday he discussed the Iran war with Chinese President Xi Jinping, as the US ambassador to China said Trump in White House talks made clear that Chinese help for Iran is unacceptable.

“We did,” Trump told reporters when asked whether he talked to Xi about Iran. “I think we’re going to do great.”

The US Ambassador to China David Perdue in a Friday CNBC interview said Trump reiterated to Xi that direct or indirect support for Iran was “totally unacceptable.”

Show Full Article

Asked separately on Fox News if that meant China would stop assisting Iran, Perdue said Washington received assurances from Beijing on Thursday.

“We’ve seen movement … on that already. That’s what the commitment is. They assured us yesterday they’re not doing that,” Perdue told Fox News’ “America’s Newsroom” program.

Trump and Xi did not take formal questions during the three-day state visit to Washington.

Earlier this month, Trump brushed aside a report that Iran acquired satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities before an attack that killed three US troops there in July.

“They basically do what we do,” Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One on September 13. “When they say China spies on us, I say you’re right and we spy on them too.”

(Reporting by Katharine Jackson, Susan Heavey and Bo Erickson; Editing by Peter Graff, Mark Porter and Chris Reese)

item.title: FTC chair suggests AI developers should be liable for conduct of agents
item.description: US Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson said on Friday he would resist describing AI agents as autonomous actors that "break loose" with "wills and desires of their own," suggesting the developers who instruct agents would be the ones liable for harm.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy
item.content:encoded: US Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson said on Friday he would resist describing AI agents as autonomous actors that "break loose" with "wills and desires of their own," suggesting the developers who instruct agents would be the ones liable for harm. "I'm going to continue as long as I am chairman to resist this anthropomorphizing of these tools," Ferguson said at the Reuters Momentum AI Austin event. "If someone tells a tool to do something, and the tool does it, I don't think we would say, 'Oh, what do we do about the tool?'" Ferguson's remarks illustrated potential avenues for the Trump administration to take as incidents rise in which agentic AI testing resulted in [USN:L6N43Q12M TEXT:"unauthorized access"] to corporate or [USN:L4N45F1E8 TEXT:"government data"]. Artificial intelligence companies have sometimes described systems as acting beyond human control, but subsequent reviews of audit trails have shown that the systems were carrying out instructions they had been given, Ferguson said. Recent [USN:L6N45604D TEXT:"incidents involving AI agents"] accessing external systems have prompted governments and industry leaders to examine whether existing oversight and cybersecurity measures are sufficient. The US should utilize existing legal tools, Ferguson said. He suggested that FTC authority to take action against companies that fail to disclose data breaches could also apply to AI developers. PERSONALIZED PRICING CONCERNS The FTC is gearing up to request data from consumer-facing companies on their use of personalized pricing, Ferguson said, referring to businesses using consumers' individual data, such as location and internet browsing history, to set prices. The practice has drawn criticism from state and federal lawmakers concerned with bolstering affordability in the US. Ferguson said last month that the FTC would not hesitate to enforce the law in this area, particularly where companies are not disclosing the practice. The FTC has already initiated enforcement actions on personalized pricing disclosures, he said. "We are in the process of trying to get a market study that will actually get to the heart of the question, which is, are particular merchants in particular markets that have access to tremendous amounts of data using that data to charge differentiated prices to different people," he said. As an individual, he said he is most concerned about use of the practice by delivery and rideshare apps, along with airlines. Airlines faced criticism last year after a Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) executive suggested AI tools were being used to gauge customers' willingness to pay. Delta has since said that it does not personalize prices based on individuals' data, and an American Airlines (AAL.O) executive has said doing so would hurt customer trust. Earlier this year, a US congressional committee [USN:L1N3ZT0W7 TEXT:"demanded information"] from Uber (UBER.N) , Instacart (CART.O) and others on whether they use customer data to set prices. Both companies said at the time that they do not use personal information to set prices. The FTC would request information from companies in order to publish a study on the practice. Ferguson's predecessor, Lina Khan, initiated a similar study into the practice, which she referred to as surveillance pricing. That study focused on companies that offer data and consulting services on pricing, rather than merchants themselves. AD FRAUD CRACKDOWN The FTC on Thursday called for public input on a potential rule that would disincentivize tech companies like Meta Platforms (META.O) and Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google from allowing fraudulent or misleading ads. Meta projected 10% of its 2024 revenue would come from ads for scams and banned goods, Reuters reported last year. The FTC has ongoing law enforcement actions related to fraudulent ads, Ferguson said. Those investigations convinced him of the need for rule-setting requirements for online platforms to mitigate fraud. "We need to make the rules hyper clear for everyone involved in this market," he said.

item.description: NEW YORK, Sept 25 : Chipmaker SK Hynix's Solidigm is considering an initial public offering as early as next year that could value the US subsidiary at up to $150 billion, according to three people familiar with the matter. Solidigm held pitch meetings this week with investment banks competing for roles on
item.dc:creator: CNA

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 25 : Chipmaker SK Hynix's Solidigm is considering an initial public offering as early as next year that could value the US subsidiary at up to $150 billion, according to three people familiar with the matter. Solidigm held pitch meetings this week with investment banks competing for roles on the IPO, in a process known as a "bake-off," one of the people and a fourth person said, marking a concrete step toward what could become the largest-ever US semiconductor listing. The company could raise $15 billion in the IPO, the three people said, speaking on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential matters. The plans, including the size of deal and timing, remain at an early stage and could change depending on market conditions, they added. The listing would rank as one of the largest semiconductor IPOs on record and could provide a standalone valuation for a business that has become a key part of SK Hynix's storage portfolio. It would also seek to tap strong investor demand for companies tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure, which has fuelled gains in semiconductor and hardware stocks.

Solidigm, based in Rancho Cordova, California, is the US-based NAND flash memory and solid-state drive (SSD) subsidiary of South Korea's SK Hynix Inc. Solidigm declined to comment. SK Hynix did not immediately respond to a request for comment. BOOSTING COMPETITIVENESS SK Hynix acquired Intel Corp's NAND memory and SSD business for about $9 billion in a deal announced in 2020, combining those operations with Solidigm, which was launched as a standalone subsidiary in 2021. At the time, the company said the acquisition would strengthen its NAND flash and enterprise SSD businesses and expand its position in the global memory market. Solidigm supplies enterprise SSDs used in servers, cloud infrastructure and data centers. The company has sought to differentiate itself through high-capacity storage products designed for AI applications, where growing volumes of data require increasingly sophisticated storage solutions. Reuters reported earlier this month that Solidigm is considering building a NAND flash memory chip factory in the US, with upstate New York emerging as a leading candidate, as part of efforts to expand manufacturing capacity. Last month, SK Hynix said it was considering measures to boost Solidigm's competitiveness after media reports that the unit was exploring a pre-IPO fundraising round of about 5 trillion won ($3.6 billion). A valuation of up to $150 billion would far exceed recent semiconductor IPOs, including Arm Holdings' roughly $54 billion valuation at its 2023 debut and Cerebras Systems' approximately $56 billion fully diluted valuation in its 2026 IPO.

item.title: Union at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile refuses to pause contract talks after fatal accident
item.description: One of the unions at Chile's Escondida mine, the world's largest copper operation, on Friday rejected BHP's attempt to delay contract talks after a worker was killed in an accident earlier this week.
item.dc:creator: Fabian Cambero
item.content:encoded: One of the unions at Chile's Escondida mine, the world's largest copper operation, on Friday rejected BHP's (BHP.AX) attempt to delay contract talks after a worker was killed in [USN:L1N45F0RG TEXT:"an accident"] earlier this week. The Australian-based miner, in an internal note seen by Reuters, said it had asked for the temporary suspension of talks with supervisors and staff because of the death, but that the negotiations would continue on schedule after the union representing supervisors refused its request. "We condemn the company for using this tragedy to seek a suspension of the ongoing collective bargaining process, especially when (unions) have repeatedly warned about poor safety conditions at the site," the supervisors' union said in a statement. In a later statement, BHP (BHP.AX) said the request was intended to focus on supporting workers after the incident. "The request for a temporary suspension of the collective bargaining process — a measure provided for in the labor code — responds precisely to this priority and to concentrating our efforts on the support, containment and care actions that this difficult moment requires," it said. The union representing the mine's rank-and-file workers said it was "unacceptable" that much of the activity in the mine continued after the accident, with only part of the operation being halted after intervention by Sernageomin, the country's mining regulator. It also criticized the company's attempt to pause the talks on a new contract with supervisors. "This request appears to be nothing more than a delaying tactic, which we categorically reject. A worker's death cannot be turned into a tool or an argument for other ends," the union said. BHP said in its statement that it fully halted mining after the accident, along with much of the rest of the site's operational areas. Supervisors are due to vote next week on the company's latest formal offer. The union representing them has urged members to reject it, potentially clearing the way for a strike. Escondida's management said late on Thursday that operations were [USN:S0N44L03A TEXT:"gradually resuming"] while the company assesses the situation following the accident. The mine, in Chile's northern Atacama Desert, is operated by BHP. Rio Tinto (RIO.L) also holds a 30% stake and Japan-based JECO owns 12.5% of it.

item.title: India's Zee escalates copyright fight against Reliance-Disney's JioStar
item.description: India's Zee Entertainment has asked the Delhi High Court to initiate contempt proceedings against Reliance-Disney joint venture JioStar, alleging it continued to use copyrighted content despite a court injunction, a legal filing shows.
item.dc:creator: Arpan Chaturvedi
item.content:encoded: India's Zee Entertainment has asked the Delhi High Court to initiate contempt proceedings against Reliance-Disney joint venture JioStar, alleging it continued to use copyrighted content [USN:L4N41J12I TEXT:"despite a court injunction"], a legal filing shows. The filing, dated September 21, escalates an ongoing copyright dispute between the companies. Zee alleges JioStar is guilty of "wilful disobedience" because it continued using Zee's music and songs in programmes broadcast on its platforms despite a court order barring such use. JioStar, formed from the $8.5 billion merger of Reliance and Disney's Indian media assets in 2024, declined to comment. Zee did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The copyright case was heard on Friday. A source aware of the details of Friday's court hearing told Reuters the Delhi High Court asked JioStar for a response to Zee's latest allegations and the case will be heard next in December. The lawsuit began in April when Zee sought $3 million in damages, citing 50 alleged copyright violations involving content from its music division. In May, the Delhi High Court ordered JioStar not to "use, publish, broadcast, stream, upload" any of Zee's licensed works. JioStar's lawyers have previously told the court the alleged infringements were "unintentional" and "purely residual in nature". The company said in May that it had removed a substantial volume of Zee content following the expiry of licensing agreements. In its latest filing, Zee cited six instances between May and July that it said showed the continued use of its copyrighted works by JioStar. JioStar is "illegally and actively exploiting" the works, Zee said in the filing. The case is one of several copyright disputes highlighting increasing competition over content rights as India's streaming and broadcasting market consolidates. JioStar, backed by billionaire Mukesh Ambani, is India's largest media and entertainment company. Zee, one of India's oldest broadcasters, is a smaller rival. The Disney-Reliance joint venture has also previously [USN:L4N41R1DU TEXT:"launched"] a legal battle against Zee, alleging the unauthorised broadcast of popular Bollywood movies at a time when JioStar held the rights to the content.

item.title: Allies unite behind Saudi Arabia as more Iranian flights restricted
item.description: Iran warned that blocking its flights could lead to similar restrictions on other countries in the Middle East region.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Allies unite behind Saudi Arabia as more Iranian flights restricted

Iran warned that blocking its flights could lead to similar restrictions on other countries in the Middle East region.

Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, and Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif pose after signing a joint defence agreement in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, Aug 7, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Saudi Press Agency)

CAIRO: Saudi , Turkish and Pakistani military chiefs are to discuss help for Saudi Arabia as it faces attacks by Yemen's Houthis , while Iraq further curtailed Iranian flights on Friday (Sep 25), in line with US pressure, and an Iranian official threatened retaliation. The Houthis have launched strikes on the Saudi -backed government in Yemen and repeatedly fired into Saudi Arabia , disrupting oil flows from the world's largest energy exporter, as part of a wider Middle East war that began with US and Israeli strikes on Iran on Feb 28. The military escalation continued this week despite a push during the UN General Assembly in New York to revive diplomacy to end the conflict, which quickly spread to Lebanon and the Gulf in March before escalating in Yemen in recent weeks. With talks stalled and during a lull in direct fire by the US and Iran, Washington had shifted tactics to extend financial sanctions by targeting companies from third countries that do business with Iranian firms through "secondary sanctions".

Iranian airlines were barred from neighbouring countries including the Unite d Arab Emirates and Oman on Thursday in response to new US sanctions , the first big impact of the shift. On Friday, the three other Iraqi airports that operate flights to and from Iran joined Baghdad airport in suspending them, sources and state media said. A flight ban, if sustained, could deepen Iran's isolation and worsen an economic crisis in the country, which is already facing a US blockade of its seaports. Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran's supreme leader, accused regional countries of "alignment with America" for blocking flights . "If Iran does not have the possibility to fly and receive airport services, then no country in the region will have this possibility either", he said in a social media post.

OIL EXPORTS SQUEEZED The war, which US President Donald Trump launched alongside Israel, has killed thousands of people and disrupted global trade and energy supplies, adding to inflationary pressures. While the fighting between the US and Iran has been stop-start, Iranian allies have mobilised, with Hezbollah attacks triggering an Israeli invasion of Lebanon and the Houthi advance in Yemen prompting a new humanitarian crisis. Iran and its allies have significantly squeezed oil exports from Saudi Arabia , a US ally. The Houthis have disrupted ship traffic at the mouth of the Red Sea, while Iran has limited tanker traffic at the Strait of Hormuz, the conduit for 20 per cent of the world's oil exports before the war. On Thursday, the Houthis said they had fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets, while Saudi authorities said they had intercepted six ballistic missiles fired by Houthi fighters. Later, Saudi Arabia 's Grand Mufti, the kingdom's top religious authority, called on soldiers to be ready to lay down their lives to fight the Houthis until the group was ousted from power. Amid the fighting, the Saudi , Pakistani and Turkish foreign ministers met on Thursday for discussions under a defence pact signed in August . They condemned attacks targeting the holy Saudi city of Mecca and other civilian sites, while affirming Saudi Arabia 's right to defend itself and planning a meeting between chiefs of staff on ways to assist the kingdom. Turkey's defence ministry said Chief of General Staff General Selcuk Bayraktaroglu was travelling to Saudi Arabia on Friday to meet his Saudi and Pakistani counterparts. Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan said the defence pact, which stipulates that an attack against one country be considered an attack against all, could lead to intelligence, logistical or ammunition support. " More advanced military support could also be considered depending on the scale of the threat," Erdogan said in written responses to Newsweek. The speaker of Turkey's parliament, which has yet to ratify the pact, said it could be expanded into a broader alliance "for the Muslim world" , including Iran.

Related:

US 'must choose' whether to end war: Iran president to Fox News

Saudi civil defence issues brief danger warning for Mecca city

SHUTTLE DIPLOMACY IN NEW YORK In New York, Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi told reporters on Thursday that Tehran had conveyed a proposal to the US via intermediaries under which the Strait of Hormuz would be reopened if Tehran’s conditions were met. Under Iran’s proposal, hostilities would end on all fronts, including Lebanon, within seven days. The US would lift its blockade on Iranian ports, release Iran’s frozen funds and waive its oil sanctions, he said. "The Strait of Hormuz will be reopened on the last day," Araqchi said, adding that talks with the US on other issues, including Iran’s nuclear issue, would then start. A senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday that Tehran was reviewing Washington's response to its peace proposals. Oil prices fell on Friday as markets weighed the possibility of a truce, despite the number of ships recorded transiting the Strait of Hormuz dropping to nine on Thursday, half the 10-day average.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: 米軍が拿捕したイラン系大型タンカー、ゆっくりと米国に向けて航海中
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米海軍がイラン戦争初期に拿捕したイラン系スーパータンカー（超大型石油タンカー）2隻が、数週間後にも米国に到着する見通しだ。米当局は船舶と、積載する数億ドル相当の原油を差し押さえる方針。イラン産原油は米国への輸入が数十年にわたり禁止されており今回の航海は異例だ。

トランプ米大統領がイランに終戦を迫るため海上封鎖を実施した4月、大型タンカー「ティファニ」と「マジェスティックX」はインド洋で米軍に拿捕された。ブルームバーグがまとめた船舶データによると、両船はこの1週間、ブラジル沿岸を航行している。拿捕された3隻目の船も喜望峰を回り、大西洋を西へ向かっていることが確認された。

米司法省は4月、ティファニとマジェスティックXの没収手続きを開始した。国土安全保障捜査局はその後、タンカー本体と、積載していた約400万バレルのイラン産原油を差し押さえるため、令状を執行していると明らかにした。3隻目のタンカー「レノア（別名ダビナ）」は6月に拿捕された。

これらのスーパータンカーはそれぞれ200万バレルを輸送でき、積み荷全体の価値は現在の市場価格で約6億ドル（約950億円）に上る。いずれも通常の12～13ノットを下回る8～9ノット程度の速度で航行している。

イラン産原油が米国の港に到着すれば、2023年に没収された貨物が運ばれて以来となる。トランプ政権は過去のタンカー拿捕で、差し押さえた船舶と原油を売却して利益を得ようとしてきた。

ただ、こうした取り組みは過去に問題にも直面している。ベネズエラ封鎖中に拿捕した180万バレルの原油を積むタンカー「スキッパー」の場合、米政府による没収申し立てに船主は抵抗し、売却の阻止に動いた。トランプ政権がこのタンカーの維持に費やしたコストは4700万ドルに膨らみ、老朽化したタンカー本体の価値の約5倍に達した。

米司法省はその後、イランの石油タンカーを戦利品として拿捕する手続きを効率化・簡素化するため、長らく休眠状態にある海事戦時裁判所を復活させる準備を進めている。

item.title: トランプ氏、習主席との会談を「生産的」と強調－詳細は明かさず
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、中国の習近平国家主席と「非常に生産的な会談」を行ったと述べた。しかし、会談での合意や進展について具体的な内容は明らかにしなかった。

トランプ氏は25日朝、SNSに投稿し、前日の会談は「米中双方」にとって有益だったとの認識を示したうえで、「今後、素晴らしいことが起きるだろう」と述べた。

ただ、投稿では貿易や輸出規制、台湾問題、AIの覇権争いへの対応など、米中関係を緊張させてきた課題について、具体的な合意や進展は示されなかった。

トランプ氏はAIにも触れたが、人工知能を「スーパーインテリジェンス」と改名しようという自らの主張に重点を置いた。この主張には揶揄（やゆ）する声が上がっているほか、AIが雇用や環境、さらには人類そのものに及ぼす脅威にトランプ氏が向き合っていないとの批判も出ている。

トランプ氏は、習氏もこの改名に賛成したと主張。「あまりいい名前ではなく、しかも実態にも合っていない『人工知能』を、もっと的確で意味のある『スーパーインテリジェンス』と呼ぶことを、彼も気に入ったようだった」と述べた。

今回の習氏のワシントン訪問は、経済・軍事上のライバル国の首脳を、レッドカーペットや軍の音楽隊の演奏、豪華な国賓晩さん会で手厚くもてなすなど、華やかな演出が目立った。ただ、主な懸案への対応では、具体的な成果はほとんどなかった。

唯一の大きな発表は、習氏が米国に到着した23日夜にベッセント財務長官が明らかにした、貿易休戦の延長だった。11月に期限を迎える予定だった休戦を、1月10日まで延長するという内容だ。中国側は延長についてまだ確認していない。

原題：Trump Claims Productive Meeting With Xi But Offers No Details（抜粋）

item.title: Morocco begin Cup of Nations qualifiers with win but Vieira's Senegal held
item.description: Morocco led the list of heavyweight contenders who got their Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaigns off to a winning start, with Algeria and Nigeria also victorious on Friday, but Senegal were held to a draw in Mozambique.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gleeson
item.content:encoded: Morocco led the list of heavyweight contenders who got their Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaigns off to a winning start, with Algeria and Nigeria also victorious on Friday, but Senegal were held to a draw in Mozambique. Patrick Vieira's debut as Senegal coach ended in a frustrating 1-1 stalemate away in Maputo as Geny Catamo thrashed home a long-range equaliser for the home side after Nicolas Jackson had put Senegal into a 32nd-minute lead in Group J. There was also a surprise home draw for Egypt, who have a record seven African titles, but were held 0-0 by Angola in Group B despite Mohamed Salah and Omar Marmoush leading their attack amidst noisy support from the Cairo crowd. Morocco, who lost to Senegal in the last Cup of Nations final but were awarded the title because Senegal staged a brief walk-off during the match in January, were 2-0 winners over Gabon in their Group A clash in Rabat. Fullback Noussair Mazraoui grabbed the 32nd-minute opener and substitute striker Soufiane Rahimi added a late second. Algeria sped into a second-minute lead against Zambia in Tizi Ouzou through Jaouen Hadjam but Fashion Sakala snaked his way through the home defence to equalise 12 minutes into the second half in Group I. Home nerves were settled with two goals in seven minutes from the attacking pair of Ibrahim Maza and Anis Hadj Moussa for a 3-1 triumph. Debutants George Ilenikhena and Moses Usor scored in a 2-1 win for Nigeria, who had an early scare at home in Uyo when Madagascar took a surprise lead through Ehsan Kari in the 16th minute. The Super Eagles fought back to take the points but looked less menacing without the injured Victor Osimhen. The Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Malawi, Mali, Niger, Rwanda, Sudan and Togo were also winners in Friday’s qualifying games. NO FAIRYTALE START FOR CAPE VERDE Mali beat tiny Cape Verde 3-1 in Bamako, denying them a fairytale first match since their World Cup heroics, with Nene Dorgeles scoring twice in the Group K encounter. Sudan's Mohammed Eisa struck four minutes from time to hand his side a 1-0 Group J win over neighbours Ethiopia with the two former African champions playing in Juba, South Sudan because of the security situation caused by the civil war in Sudan. Muhammed Badamossi scored Gambia's winner in a 2-1 home victory over Somalia in Group C, while Dominic Njaliwa was Malawi’s hero as they beat South Sudan by the same scoreline in Blantyre in Group B. Dermane Karim netted early as Togo edged visitors Burundi in Group I, while German-born brothers Leroy-Jacques and Joy-Lance Mickels scored for Rwanda, who beat Liberia 3-1 in Kigali. A third brother, Joy-Slayd, was an unused substitute in the first competitive match in charge for Rwanda's English coach Stephen Constantine. The top two in the 12 groups advance to next year’s finals, co-hosted by Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda, except in groups where the hosts are playing, from which one other team will qualify.

item.title: 米中首脳、親密な関係強調 年内あと2回の会談に意欲
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席は２５日、ホワイトハウスで茶会に臨んだ後、米国立公文書館を訪問し、３日間にわたる首脳会談を締めくくった。経済関係などを巡る大きな進展よりも、親密な関係をアピールする首脳外交の色彩が際立った。また、両首脳とも年内にあと２回会談する可能性を示唆した。

両首脳は、メラニア夫人、彭麗媛夫人とともにホワイトハウスの応接室「レッドルーム」での茶会に出席し、互いを称賛した。トランプ大統領は、世界二大経済大国による今回の首脳会談で「大きな進展」があったとした上で、「米国は今回の訪問を大いに歓迎しており、中国側も同様だと確信している」と述べた。

さらに、「米農家も喜ぶだろう」と語ったが、詳細には踏み込まなかった。

また、両国は今後も「頻繁に話し合うことになるだろう」との認識を示した。

習氏は、両国関係が「相互尊重、公平、互恵に基づく戦略的安定」という建設的な関係へ発展したと述べ、米中関係をより実りあるものにしていくことでトランプ大統領と一致したと語った。

さらに、今年終盤に中国・深圳で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議と、米マイアミで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議に合わせ、トランプ大統領と年内にあと２回会談する機会があるとの見方を示した。

トランプ大統領も、これら首脳会議に合わせ、１１月に中国、１２月に米国で再び会談する見通しだと述べた。また、今回の会談は「成功」だったとし、これからも多くのことが成し遂げられるとの期待を表明した。

両首脳はその後、国立公文書館を訪れ、米独立宣言や合衆国憲法、権利章典など、米国の歴史を象徴する文書を見学したもよう。

中国側は公文書館訪問についてコメントしていないが、アナリストらは、習氏が１９７９年の米中国交正常化や、台湾との断交に関連する記録に関心を示している可能性があると指摘していた。

中国側の発表によると、習氏は２４日の会談で台湾問題を取り上げた。中国国営通信の新華社によると、習氏は「米国が台湾問題を慎重に扱い、中米間の戦略的協力と両国関係の発展に向けた強固な基盤を築くことを望む」とトランプ氏に伝えた。また新華社の英語版は、習氏が米国に「台湾独立に反対する」ことを望んだとも報じた。

また、イラン情勢に関する記者団の質問に対し、トランプ大統領は習氏と協議したことを明らかにした上で、詳細には触れず、「うまくいくと思う」と述べるにとどめた。

item.title: マイクロソフト、「コパイロット」刷新 ＡＩ機能拡充でライバルに対抗
item.description:
Deborah Mary Sophia
[２５日 ロイター] - 米ＩＴ大手マイクロソフトは２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）ア...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マイクロソフト、「コパイロット」刷新　ＡＩ機能拡充でライバルに対抗 0:33 配信

７月２０日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Deborah Mary Sophia

[２５日　ロイター] - 米ＩＴ大手マイクロソフトは２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）アシスタント「コパイロット」の刷新を発表した。常時稼働する自律型ＡＩエージェントといった新機能を導入。米オープンＡＩの生成ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」やアンソロピックの「クロード」との競争が激しくなる中、ＡＩ機能の拡充によりライバルに対抗する狙い。

「Ｏｆｆｉｃｅ（オフィス）」アプリのＷｏｒｄ、Ｅｘｃｅｌ、ＰｏｗｅｒＰｏｉｎｔが「コパイロット」に統合され、利用者は「コパイロット」を使いながら、アプリで共同作業ができるようになる。

マイクロソフトの幹部は「セキュリティーや法令順守、企業統治上の懸念から、エージェント導入が困難だった企業が多い」とし「実際に活用できるよう取り組んだ」と述べた。

自然言語で指示を出すとアプリなどのソフトウエアを構築できる「Ｃｏｄｅ」は、ＧｉｔＨｕｂ（ギットハブ）コパイロットと同じ技術を採用している。一部の利用者には今月内に提供を開始し、年内に対象者を拡大する。

今年６月に発表したＡＩエージェント「スカウト」を刷新した「Ａｕｔｏｐｉｌｏｔ」は、９月末に早期利用が可能な一部の顧客向けに公開する。

item.title: 原油相場は小幅安、ホルムズ海峡巡る期待とタイトな需給のせめぎ合い
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニューヨーク時間25日の原油相場は下落した。米国とイランの交渉担当者はホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けて段階的な合意を模索している。

ウエスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）先物は1バレル＝94ドル付近で取引されている。イランがホルムズ海峡の通航を認め、米国がイランの港湾封鎖を解除する方向で、両国は合意を目指していると、前日に関係者が明らかにした。

ただ、交戦する双方はこれまでも何度も合意間近とみられながら、協議が決裂してきた。現物原油市場では需給逼迫の兆候がなお見られ、多くのトレーダーは供給が大幅に増えるのを確認するまでポジションの変更に慎重な姿勢を示している。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ大統領がイランとの対話を排除していないと述べる一方、制裁措置と封鎖によって米国は強い立場にあるため、交渉の必要はないと強調した。

スタンダード・チャータードのエネルギー調査責任者、エミリー・アシュフォード氏は「同様の合意はこれまで何度も発表されてきたが、進展は見られなかった」と指摘。「外交上の打開があったとしても、途絶した供給が直ちに回復するわけではなく、海上輸送が正常化するわけでもない。在庫減少に歯止めがかかるわけでも、信頼感が改善するわけでもない」と述べた。

今週を通じて原油価格は、和平の見通しを巡る強弱混在のシグナルや、中東からの供給増加の兆し、米国がディーゼル燃料の輸出を禁止する可能性を巡る観測に揺さぶられてきた。ブレント原油は今年に入りなお70%余り上昇しており、インフレ圧力を強めている。

25日の市場では期近先物が下落する一方、広く注目されている一部の指標は、将来の供給に対する懸念が高止まりしていることを示した。その一つであるブレント原油のプロンプトスプレッド（直近2限月の価格差）は、先月末の1バレル＝1ドル未満から、6.50ドル超に拡大した。バックワーデーションと呼ばれるこの強気の価格構造は、需給逼迫を象徴する。

US appeals court upholds Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic

FILE PHOTO: An Anthropic logo is displayed at Moscone Center during the Dreamforce 2026 technology summit in San Francisco, California, US, September 17, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

25 Sep 2026 11:24PM (Updated: 26 Sep 2026 01:54AM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 25 :  A federal appeals court upheld on Friday the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic from military contracts, handing a victory to President Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in their battle with the AI startup over safety guardrails on its technology. The 2-1 decision by the US Court of Appeals in Washington, D.C. came in a lawsuit by Anthropic challenging its March designation by the Pentagon as a national security supply chain risk, which the startup says has cost it billions of dollars in lost business and damaged its reputation ahead of a highly anticipated initial public offering.  The court's majority said it was reasonable for the Pentagon to designate Anthropic after it refused to allow its products to be used for autonomous weapons or mass surveillance. It rejected Anthropic's claim that the Pentagon had retaliated against it for its views on AI safety and ethics. Siding with Hegseth's argument that Anthropic's safety restrictions could compromise military operations, the majority said: “The Secretary raises the deeply sobering prospect of overly constrained AI models shutting down unexpectedly and thus causing important military operations to fail," in an opinion by Judge Gregory Katsas.

San Francisco-based Anthropic said in a statement Friday that it respectfully disagrees with the decision but remains confident in its position and is considering its options, including review of the three-judge panel's decision by the full appeals court.  The White House and the Department of Defense did not immediately respond to emails seeking comment.  A federal judge in San Francisco last month struck down a parallel designation under a different law, finding the administration had unlawfully retaliated against Anthropic for its views on AI safety. US District Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco also blocked Trump's government-wide ban on Anthropic and Hegseth's order barring military contractors from doing any business with the startup. Hegseth designated Anthropic as a risk under two different laws after Anthropic refused to remove guardrails against its technology being used for autonomous weapons or mass domestic surveillance. The unprecedented move came after months of negotiations ended in failure and public recriminations by Hegseth and Trump, who accused Anthropic of endangering American lives with ideological posturing.  Anthropic denied that characterization and said AI is not yet reliable enough to be safely used in autonomous weapons. The company also said it opposes domestic surveillance as a violation of fundamental rights.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米カンザスシティー連銀総裁、インフレ問題に十分対処できていない
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米カンザスシティー連銀のシュミッド総裁は25日、物価上昇率が米金融当局の目標である2%を上回っており、政策当局はインフレ問題にまだ十分対処できていないとの認識を示した。

シュミッド総裁はカンザスシティーでの討論会で「インフレ問題はまだ解決できていない」と述べ、「インフレ率が目標を上回る状態が5年以上続いている」と指摘した。

さらに、政策当局者は株式市場のバリュエーションや経済の動向を注視しているものの、個別の動きを細かく追い過ぎることはないと述べた。

シュミッド総裁は「AIやデータセンターの建設拡大で何が起きているのかをしっかり把握する必要がある。われわれは『大き過ぎてつぶせない』AIエコシステムに向かっているのか」と発言。「われわれがデータを通じて見極めようとしているのはそこだと思う。システム全体に関わる問題が何かあるのかということだ」と述べた。

同総裁は今年、金融政策決定で議決権を持たないが、政策金利の誘導目標を3.75－4%に引き上げた今月の利上げを支持したとこれまでに述べている。

原題：Fed’s Schmid Says Officials Haven’t Fixed Inflation Issue（抜粋）

item.title: ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁 0:08 配信

2023年6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームに伴い、業界で形成されつつある企業や契約のネットワークが「大きすぎてつぶせない（too big to fail）」問題に発展していないかを米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が把握することが重要との認識を示した。

シュミッド総裁は、「ＡＩやデータセンターの構築を巡って何が起きているのかを真に包括的に理解するため、まず考えなければならないのは、『大きすぎてつぶせない』ＡＩエコシステムへ移行しつつあるのかどうかだ」と述べた。２００７─０９年の金融危機の際、主要金融機関がその規模と実体経済への影響力ゆえに公的救済を必要とした事態に言及した発言だ。

その上で「システム的なリスクは存在するのか」との問題を提起した。

item.title: US Federal Reserve plans to raise bank oversight thresholds, sources say
item.description: The US Federal Reserve is set to propose an increase in the asset thresholds for banking regulations, potentially raising the current $700 billion limit to around $960 billion. This adjustment could benefit lenders by reducing compliance costs and easing regulatory burdens for banks near the threshold. However, analysts caution that such changes may spur consolidation among mid-sized banks, which could undermine competition and elevate systemic risks in the financial sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Reserve is working on a plan to raise the asset thresholds that trigger stricter oversight of big banks, four people with knowledge of the matter said, which would allow some lenders to avoid costly additional regulation and potentially spur consolidation.The central bank is expected to soon propose reindexing the thresholds where banks become subject to stress tests of their balance sheets, liquidity, capital and other more stringent rules, to account for inflation and economic growth, the people said. Three of the people said they expect the Fed to propose the changes later this year.Current rules impose stricter requirements when a bank reaches $100 billion in assets, stepping up at $250 billion and again at $700 billion. Lenders say those thresholds, set in 2019, haven't kept pace with the economy, subjecting banks to increasingly stringent oversight that exceeds the risks they pose.Banks say crossing the $100 billion threshold typically requires major investment in compliance staff, risk management systems, stress-testing capabilities and regulatory reporting infrastructure that can run into tens of millions of dollars annually.The Fed is considering reindexing the highest threshold closer to $1 trillion and some of the requirements triggered by the lower threshold closer to $150 billion, said the people, who declined to be named as they were discussing sensitive regulatory issues.Banks that stand to benefit include U.S. Bancorp, Capital One, PNC Financial and Truist, which are closest to the $700 billion threshold, giving them more room to grow without incurring some of the toughest Fed oversight, including aspects of new incoming capital rules and daily reporting requirements to supervisors.Western Alliance, Zions and several others, meanwhile, could grow beyond $100 billion without incurring all the requirements currently imposed on lenders in that category. Pinnacle Financial Partners and one or two other lenders sitting between $100 billion and $150 billion could even shed some requirements.A Fed spokesperson declined to comment. In January, Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said the central bank would consider reindexing the thresholds and suggested using nominal GDP, but the Fed has not commented since then. The US economy has grown significantly over the past seven years, and it makes sense to have rules for all banks that will help consumers and small businesses through increased bank lending capacity and more competition, a U.S. Bancorp spokesperson said.The other banks either declined to comment or did not respond to requests for comment.CHANGES COULD SPUR MID-SIZE BANK DEALSThe plan is part of a broader effort by the Trump administration to reform bank oversight which officials say is stifling lending and the economy. Bowman is also overhauling capital rules and other aspects of the Fed's supervisory regime.The changes could lead consolidation among mid-size lenders which have been holding off for fear of breaching the thresholds, the people said. Revised thresholds can reduce downsides of growth and change relative costs/benefits of acquisitions, analysts at Truist wrote on Friday in response to Reuters' story.Banks with $50 billion to $700 billion of assets announced just 33 bank and thrift acquisitions over the past decade, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence, with just seven such deals last year, including Fifth Third's $10.9 billion acquisition of Comerica. We would expect this to unlock M&A activity among mid-cap and regional banks that have been in a holding pattern, said James Stevens, partner at law firm Troutman Pepper Locke, adding bank boards would be able to assess deals on merit rather than on the regulatory math. One banking industry executive said raising the $700 billion threshold would allow larger lenders to more effectively compete with the country's four biggest consumer banks.Critics of bank consolidation argue it harms consumers by reducing competition and services, while increasing systemic risks.BANKS HAVE LONG ARGUED THRESHOLDS ARE ARBITRARYFollowing the US financial crisis, the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act set supervisory thresholds, which Congress softened in 2018. That law mandates some requirements that only Congress can change, including stress tests for banks in the $100 billion bucket and enhanced prudential standards for those above $250 billion.But the law also gave the Fed broad discretion, and the central bank imposed additional capital planning, liquidity and reporting requirements for the $100 billion category. It also created the $700 billion category to ensure sufficient oversight for big banks not deemed globally systemically important banks, which are subject to a separate regime.Banks have long said the thresholds are arbitrary and can distort business decisions by encouraging banks to stay below them.Reindexing using nominal GDP would incorporate inflation and economic growth. It could push the highest threshold to around $960 billion and the lower threshold for the additional Fed requirements to roughly $150 billion.Democrats say Congress already watered down the rules in 2018, and asset thresholds, though imperfect, offer a simple way to calibrate requirements.

FAST

WASHINGTON: The United States is expected to release details on the outcome of trade negotiations with China on Monday (Sep 28), US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday. US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday but there was l ittle sign of a breakthrough on a host of sensitive issues. "We're in a managed trade situation ... we've had progress, and we will release on Monday, I think, a lot more details about what we've accomplished over the past few weeks in negotiating with the Chinese," he told CNBC. The US has agreed with China on exempting some key goods from arguments over trade, he said. The US would send agricultural products and medical devices "and we're getting from them, you know, consumer goods and other things that are non-sensitive", he added.

"We've actually reached agreement with the Chinese on a number of these things in areas where, you know if we have trade disputes in the future or if there are tariff measures in the future, we just leave those things to the side." Greer also said that the current talks did not cover a small amount of high-quality US-made chips requiring licenses. "These are the crown jewels of American technology. It's the way we stay ahead in the race for superintelligence, or AI, and so those conversations ... (are) not really happening in these negotiations," he said. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this week and said they had agreed to extend until Jan 10 a deal that paused a trade war that saw mutual tariffs top 100 per cent.

item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２５日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．１と、８月の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感9月確報は48.1、4カ月ぶり低水準  9/25 23:59 配信

2026年8月26日、米国ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２５日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．１と、８月の５１．７から低下し、４カ月ぶりの低水準となった。インフレ加速が家計の購買力を損なうとの懸念が背景にある。ただ、速報値の４７．８からは改善した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４７．６だった。同指数は１月から１５％低下している。現在および今後１年間の家計に対する見方はいずれも約１０％悪化し、高インフレへの懸念が引き続き強まった。消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「全体として、年初来で経済見通しが悪化したという点で、政治的立場を超えた幅広い一致が調査から浮かび上がった」と指摘。「今月は特に大きく信頼感が落ち込んだ結果、共和党支持層の信頼感は２０２６年１月と比べ２０％低い水準にある。民主党支持層も同期間に１３％低下した」と述べた。１年後のインフレ期待は４．６％と、８月の４．０％から上昇した。イランとの紛争が始まる前の２月時点の３．４％から急上昇している。５年後のインフレ期待は３．４％と、小幅に上昇した。前月までは３カ月連続で３．３％を維持していた。

item.title: 米中貿易交渉の詳細、28日公表 ＵＳＴＲ代表「進展あった」
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、中国との貿易交渉の結果に関する詳細を２８日に公表する見通しだと明らかにした。

グリア代表はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、「われわれは管理貿易の状況にある。進展はあった。ここ数週間の対中交渉で達成した内容について、２８日により詳細な情報を公表する予定だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席とホワイトハウスで首脳会談を行ったが、多くの懸案事項について具体的な打開策が示された兆候は限定的だった。

グリア代表は、米中が貿易摩擦の対象から一部の主要品目を除外することで合意したと述べた。米国からの農産物や医療機器の輸出、中国からの消費財や機密性の低い品目の輸入に言及し、「将来的に貿易紛争や関税措置が発生しても、これらの品目は対象外となる」と述べた。

一方、輸出にライセンスが必要な少量の高性能な米国製半導体については協議の対象となっていないと説明。「これらは米国技術の至宝であり、超知能や人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発競争で米国が優位を維持するための手段だ。だからこそ、これらに関する対話は今回の交渉では実際には行われていない」と語った。

ベセント財務長官は２３日、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」について、両国が２カ月間延長することで合意したと明らかにした。より包括的な貿易協定に向けた協議の時間を確保することが目的としている。

item.title: ローマ教皇、国際対話は「茶番」を化す恐れ 国連は実効性の危機に直面と警告
item.description:
Joshua McElwee Elizabeth Pineau
[パリ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joshua McElwee　Elizabeth Pineau

[パリ　２５日　ロイター] - ローマ教皇レオ１４世は２５日、国連や他の多国間組織が危機に直面していると述べ、国際対話が「茶番」と化す恐れがあると警告した。国連教育科学文化機関（ユネスコ）のパリ本部で行った演説で語った。

教皇はこの日、４日間の日程でフランス入りした。演説では、特定の個人名を挙げることなく、法の支配を軽視する世界の指導者らを非難し、「権力者は、法を尊重する代わりに、自らの利益にかなう時にだけ法を持ち出し、自分たちの行動を制約する時には無視する。正義そのものをまるで売買するための商品のように扱っている」と述べた。

さらに、国連や他の多国間組織は「実効性の危機に直面している」とし、「対話は、平和のための資源ではなく行動の障害と見なされ、共に公益を追求する機会ではなく、茶番として扱われている」と語った。

２０２５年５月に初の米国出身教皇として就任したレオ１４世は、今年に入り、イラン戦争を批判してトランプ米大統領の怒りを買った。

item.title: Fed's Schmid: Need to understand if AI "ecosystem" getting too big to fail
item.description: Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said that as the artificial intelligence boom unfolds it will be important for the Fed to understand if the network of firms and contracts developing in the industry is becoming so large it is too big to fail.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said that as the artificial intelligence boom unfolds it will be important for the Fed to understand if the network of firms and contracts developing in the industry is becoming so large it is too big to fail. "Where we have to start to really synthesize what's happening in the AI and the data center build-out is are we moving to a too-big-to-fail AI ecosystem," he said, referring to the need for public bailouts of major financial institutions during the 2007 to 2009 financial crisis because of their size and influence on the broader economy. "You worry a little bit about how do we understand what's inside. ... Is there anything systemic?" he asked.

item.title: ハイパースケーラーAI投資、来年は5割増の1.2兆ドルに－ゴールドマン
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国の大手ハイパースケーラー5社によるAIインフラへの支出は、来年に5割超増加し、1兆2000億ドル（約188兆円）に達する見通しだ。ゴールドマン・サックス・グループのストラテジストが明らかにした。

ライアン・ハモンド氏率いるチームはリポートで、この数字は2027年の設備投資についての市場予想1兆1000億ドルを上回ると指摘。各社が投資を回収するには、今後数年間に年間約3000億ドルのAI関連収入が必要になるとの見方を示した。

ハモンド氏らは「市場予想に基づくと、2027年の設備投資が国内総生産（GDP）に占める割合は、1800年代後半の鉄道建設以来、どの技術投資サイクルよりも高くなる見通しだ」と指摘した。

アマゾン・ドット・コム、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、オラクル、メタ・プラットフォームズの5社は今年、AI能力の拡充に8000億ドルを投じる見通しだ。来年の支出額は大幅に増えるものの、設備投資の拡大ペースは鈍化する見込みだと、ゴールドマンのチームは指摘した。

ストラテジストは「設備投資の伸び率と市場予想に対する上振れの度合いはいずれも、ここ数四半期に比べて低下する」と記した。ハイパースケーラーの設備投資は現在、営業キャッシュフローを上回っており、債券発行や株式による資金調達の必要性が高まっている。電力や労働力、メモリーの不足に加え、データセンター建設への規制が制約要因となる可能性がある。

ストラテジストは、ハイパースケーラーの設備投資の伸び率が今年の約100%から2027年には54%、2028年には12%に鈍化すると予想している。2028年の設備投資額は1兆4000億ドルに達する見通しだ。

ハイパースケーラーが十分な投資収益を確保し、アプリケーション事業者もコンピューティング費用に対して高い利益率を得るには、AI利用者がアプリケーションに年間約1兆ドルを支出する必要があると、ストラテジストらは指摘した。2026年の世界のソフトウエア支出は約1兆5000億ドルだった。

item.title: Man City found guilty on all but one of 115 charges, reports say, with appeal expected
item.description: Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, The Athletic reported on Friday, a potentially seismic development in a case that has hung over English football for years.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, The Athletic reported on Friday, a potentially seismic development in a case that has hung over English football for years. The club are expected to appeal, indicating that the process was not yet complete. They have always denied any wrongdoing. "The Premier League process remains ongoing, with significant elements to be completed, and subject to strict confidentiality," the club said in a statement to British media. "As such Manchester City FC's position remains consistent with the club's statement of February 2023. "The club has diligently respected due process for eight years on the basis the Premier League board and executive would behave as an independent, impartial and fair minded regulator, free from partisan influence." The Premier League declined to comment. "It’s a confidential process, we’re not commenting at all," a spokesperson said. A guilty verdict would represent one of the most significant rulings in English football history in a case that has overshadowed the league for more than three years. The proceedings have raised questions about financial regulation, competitive integrity and how the league enforces its rules against its most successful clubs. ALLEGATIONS SPANNING MORE THAN A DECADE The Premier League referred City to an independent commission in February 2023 over [USN:L4N34M29T TEXT:"alleged breaches"] of financial rules spanning the 2009-10 to 2022-23 seasons. The club have consistently denied wrongdoing. Among the most serious allegations was that City failed in each season from 2009-10 to 2017-18 to provide accurate financial information giving a "true and fair view" of revenues, including sponsorship income, and operating costs. City hired lawyer David Pannick to lead their defence, while the Premier League was represented by Adam Lewis, according to British media reports. The hearing began on September 16, 2024, and concluded nearly three months later on December 6. The case was heard by an independent commission composed of three people appointed by the independent chair of the Premier League Judicial Panel. Former City midfielder Rodri said on Friday he had always trusted the club's insistence that it had done nothing wrong and said the players had shared that belief throughout the case. "Hopefully, justice can be done, whatever happens obviously, but I trust in the impunity of that club which I know very well. And they always transmitted their confidence that they’d done everything correctly," he told a press conference on the eve of Spain's Nations League game against England at Wembley. "Until the moment they’re proved wrong, we will believe the club and I've been there and I know how they work and how they cooperate," said the midfielder who now plays for Barcelona. European soccer's governing body UEFA banned City from the Champions League for two years by in 2020 after finding the club had overstated sponsorship revenue between 2012 and 2016. City, however, successfully appealed to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), which overturned the ban. Since Sheikh Mansour’s Abu Dhabi United Group bought the club in 2008, City have won eight Premier League titles, the Champions League, four FA Cups and seven League Cups. City currently top the Premier League after winning each of their opening five matches. Rodri believes nothing can diminish City's achievements. "What we did, they cannot take out of us. It's something that is not paid by money, it's paid with effort, with partnership, with being shoulder to shoulder every day," he said. "We had a lot of successful years and here in Wembley, so I can only tell you that everything was deserved and I'm glad I could live one of the best eras of English football in here," he added referring to City's Cup triumphs at the stadium. HIGH STAKES The stakes are particularly high because other clubs have already faced sporting sanctions for breaching financial regulations. Everton were docked a total of eight points during the 2023-24 season after two separate breaches of the Premier League's Profitability and Sustainability Rules, while Nottingham Forest were deducted four points for a breach of the same rules in March 2024. Newcastle United narrowly avoided potential sanctions after selling players before a June 30, 2024, financial reporting deadline to comply with spending regulations. The allegations against City are far broader and cover more than a decade, making the case unprecedented in scale. Lawyers, club executives and supporters across the league have spent years awaiting a verdict. Ian Hargreaves, partner at specialist disputes firm Quillon Law, said the "rumoured verdict is not the end of the story but the beginning of a new phase in what has become one of the most closely watched legal battles in global sport." The key questions raised, he said, are what sanctions the panel considers proportionate and what guidance can be drawn from previous cases. "There is a wide range of options, with a transfer ban at the more moderate end of the spectrum and expulsion from the league the most severe repercussion," Hargreaves said. "There is also the question of whether the panel’s decision can withstand a hard-fought appeal, and on what grounds any challenge might be brought. Much will depend on the detail of the panel’s findings and reasoning, which will inevitably be closely scrutinised by both sides." Responding to the reports, Caroline Dinenage, chair of Britain's Culture, Media and Sport select committee, urged that due process be followed while calling for the case to be concluded as quickly as possible. "The reports ... have profound implications for our national game," Dinenage said in a statement. “The extraordinary length and cost of this process raise serious concerns, and the affair again gives rise to questions about financial fairness across the football pyramid. “The matter must be allowed to take its course and due process must be followed, but I sincerely hope any further stages are completed as swiftly as is reasonably possible.”

item.title: トランプ氏、対加通商交渉に満足 「急ぐ理由ない」＝ＵＳＴＲ代表
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、ＣＮＢＣに対し、対カナダ通商交渉について、トランプ大統領は現状に満足していると述べた。来週にはカナダ製品を対象とした新たな米輸入禁止措置が発効し、米政府は来年１月からカナダ製の自動車、部品、鉄鋼に５０％の関税を課すと警告しているが、トランプ政権はカナダとの通商対立を維持することに問題はなく、米国側に急ぐ理由はないとした。

この発言は、米政府が譲歩の必要をほとんど感じていないことを示している。

米国が近く導入する輸入禁止措置は、アルコール飲料、オートバイ、乳製品を含む幅広いカナダ製品が対象。１月の関税５０％への引き上げは、北米の自動車生産に重大な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

一方、カナダによる米製品への報復関税は今月に入って発効した。

グリア代表は「石油、ガス、カリ肥料など、必要なものは依然としてカナダから得られている。農産物も国境を越えて相互に出荷しており、両国間には引き続き活発な貿易がある」と述べた。その上で「われわれは現状に満足している。カナダは時折こちらに連絡してきて、合意の可能性について良好な対話を行っているが、米国側に急ぐ理由はないと言える」と語った。

在ワシントンのカナダ大使館は現時点でコメントしていない。

一部の専門家は、トランプ政権がまずメキシコとの合意を目指しているとみている。これによりカナダとより有利な合意を結ぶための交渉力が高まる可能性があるためという。メキシコ当局者は今週、メキシコとの次回交渉が１０月に行われる可能性があると述べた。

item.title: 米消費者マインド指数、4カ月ぶり低水準－物価高や先行きを懸念
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ミシガン大学が発表した9月の消費者マインド指数（確報値）は前月から低下し、4カ月ぶりの低水準となった。物価上昇や景気の先行きに対する懸念が強まった。

消費者マインド悪化の背景には、ディーゼル価格が過去最高を記録し、ガソリン価格も上昇したことがある。給油時の負担増が、生活費を巡る労働者の根強い不満に拍車をかけている。

インフレが高止まりし、物価の伸びは賃金の伸びを上回っている。住宅ローン金利は7%超に急上昇し、多くの人にとって住宅取得が一段と困難になっている。

ミシガン大の消費者調査ディレクター、ジョアン・シュー氏は発表文で、「政治的な立場の違いにかかわらず、消費者は一様に景気の先行きが悪化したとみている」と指摘した。

今年に入り、消費者マインド指数は年齢や学歴、地域、支持政党、所得のいずれの層でも低下している。

1年先の景気見通しを示す指数は9月に急低下し、2022年以来の低水準となった。家計の先行きに対する見方も悪化した。

耐久財の購入環境は小幅に改善したが、「今のうちに購入を済ませれば、将来の値上がりを避けられるとの消費者の見方」を一部反映したものだとシュー氏は分析した。

原題：US Consumer Sentiment Falls on Worries About Prices, Economy (1)（抜粋）

item.title: 再送「強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致」、日米財務相が電話会談
item.description:
(見出しを修正します)
［東京 ２５日 ロイター］ - 日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
再送「強い円が望ましいとの認識で一致」、日米財務相が電話会談 9/25 23:08 配信

2026年8月3日、片山さつき財務相。REUTERS/Issei Kato/File Photo

(見出しを修正します)

［東京　２５日　ロイター］ - 日本の財務省は、片山さつき財務相とベセント米財務長官が日本時間の２５日夜、電話で会談したと発表した。同省の声明によると、両氏は円の過小評価が懸念事項であることを改めて確認。金融市場の動向等に関して意見交換を行い、両国間の協力をさらに強化していくことも再確認したという。

一方、ベセント長官もＸへの投稿で、片山財務相との電話会談は有意義なものだったと表明。日本の力強い経済のファンダメンタルズを反映した強い円が望ましいことや、為替市場について緊密な意思疎通を続けることの重要性を協議したと述べた。

また、今回の電話会談は、今週行われたトランプ大統領と高市首相の協議を踏まえたもので、日米パートナーシップの強固さを反映するものだったと説明した。

これを受け、外国為替市場では円がドルに対して上げ幅を拡大。円は対ドルで１．０９％高の１ドル＝１５７．１３円と、４日続落に終止符を打ち、１日としては９月７日以来最大の上昇率となる見通しとなった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：主要国債利回りが軒並み歴史的高水準、債務持続性巡る不安と利上げ圧力で コラム：ベセント発言過信の危うさ、円相場の現在地を考える＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：米財務長官の「リフレ政策をやめろ」発言をどう受け取るか＝熊野英生氏 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 アングル：「どう暮らせばいいのか」生活苦深まるイラン市民、指導部は抗議再燃を警戒 最終更新: 9/26(土) 0:44 ロイター

item.description: PARIS, Sept 25 : The organisers of the prestigious Goncourt literary prize said on Friday they had removed a smash-hit novel by Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien from their longlist after accusations he used AI to write it.Orelien denied using AI to write "C'etait Ca ou Mourir" ("It Was Either That or
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

France's prestigious Goncourt prize drops novel after author accused of using AI

A copie of the book "C'etait ca ou mourir", a novel by author Thelyson Orelien, is displayed on a table inside a bookstore in Paris, France, September 22, 2026. REUTERS Sarah Meyssonnier

FAST

PARIS, Sept 25 : The organisers of the prestigious Goncourt literary prize said on Friday they had removed a smash-hit novel by Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien from their longlist after accusations he used AI to write it. Orelien denied using AI to write "C'etait Ca ou Mourir" ("It Was Either That or Die") as the allegations ignited a debate about race, literary merit and originality that has roiled the French literary establishment. The accusations about AI use were made this week by a little-known X account "Balance ton Claude." Essayist Samuel Fitoussi later claimed ownership of the account, saying he managed it with other unidentified individuals. The AI accusations were followed by reports that Orelien had committed plagiarism in earlier works. La Presse said that a 2012 short story by Orelien had plagiarized passages from a book by French author Louis Pauwels, while a 2013 opinion piece copied from The Philippine Star newspaper.

Orelien has yet to respond to those accusations, and did not respond to a request for comment on Friday. The Paris-based Academie Goncourt said it had taken note of the AI and plagiarism accusations, and had decided to remove his novel "to preserve the integrity of the Goncourt Prize and that of the Academie, whose central role is to promote and honour literature written by women and men." The Academie said it hoped its decision would show it was fully against the "creation of texts generated with the assistance of AI," adding it would make no further comment before October 6, when it will announce its shortlist. The debut novel by the Haitian-born author tells the story of a Haitian migrant who travels north through Latin America before ending up in Canada. It has won a host of other literary awards, and was due to be translated into multiple languages. His French and Canadian publishers initially offered Orelien their full support over the AI allegations. They did not respond to requests for comment on Friday. "Balance ton Claude" said that running passages through AI detection tool Pangram showed the novel "was written almost entirely by artificial intelligence". Some experts say the reliability of AI detection tools is questionable.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米テレビ各社、トランプ氏取材再開へ 排除措置巡り違憲訴訟継続＝ＣＮＮ
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ＣＮＮの記者は２５日、テレビ各社がトランプ大統領に関連するイベントの取材を再開する見通しだと明らかにした。トランプ政権による米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米ＣＮＮの記者は２５日、テレビ各社がトランプ大統領に関連するイベントの取材を再開する見通しだと明らかにした。トランプ政権による米メディアのＣＮＮ、ＭＳ ＮＯＷ、ポリティコのホワイトハウス排除を巡っては、依然として裁判が続いている。

ＣＮＮによると、トランプ氏が中国の習近平国家主席と共に、米国の憲法など建国関連の文書が収蔵されている国立公文書館を視察する予定の２５日、ＣＮＮも現地で取材する。

ＣＮＮのクリステン・ホームズ記者は２５日、前日に取材アクセスが復活したホワイトハウス敷地内から放送で「代表取材（プール取材）が実施される予定だ」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスの担当者は現時点でコメント要請に応じていない。

トランプ氏が１８日にホワイトハウスから締め出すと表明したことを受け、３社は２１日、トランプ政権を提訴した。ホワイトハウスは２４日、連邦地裁がトランプ氏による締め出し措置について違憲の可能性が高いとし、アクセスを直ちに回復するよう命じたことを受け、３社の記者のホワイトハウス立ち入りを認めたと明らかにしていた。

item.title: ECB、要職の後任争いが本格化－シュナーベル氏退任で時間的圧力
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のシュナーベル理事が早期退任の見通しとなったことで、ラガルド総裁の後任を含むECB要職を巡る争いがますます激しくなりそうだ。

ECBは24日、ドイツ出身のシュナーベル氏は任期をまだ1年残す来年1月に理事を退任すると発表した。3カ月余りの間にECB主要ポストに1つ空席ができることを意味しており、各国政府は早急な対応が必要となった。

ラガルド総裁とチーフエコノミストのレーン氏も2027年に退任予定で、総裁自身も早期退任を示唆している。こうした状況から、ECBトップ人事が一括して決定される公算が極めて大きい。年内に予定される3回の欧州連合（EU）首脳会議で、この人事を巡る駆け引きが繰り広げられることになりそうだ。

こうした人事の決定は、2019年にラガルド氏が任命された際と同様に、各国の対立の場となるリスクをはらむ。約3億6000万人の人口を抱えるユーロ圏の金融政策を主導するECB役員会の半数の席が空く事態に、それぞれが自国の候補の起用を求めるためだ。

ベレンベルクのチーフエコノミスト、ホルガー・シュミーディング氏は「ECB人事の決定は、今や時間的なプレッシャーがある」と指摘。「一括した決定は困難だろう。だが、決定が難しくても解決策を見いだすのが政治家の仕事だ」と述べた。

人事決定の期限が迫る一方で、域内大国は政治的に難しい時期にある。ドイツの与党は州議選での敗北が相次ぎ、メルツ政権は存続が危うい状況だ。フランスは来年春の大統領選挙を前に、政治的な行き詰まりに陥っている。イタリア、スペインも総選挙が近い。

EUのあらゆる決定と同様に、こう着状態に陥る危険も排除できない。シュナーベル氏自身、ブルームバーグが入手したECBスタッフに対する別れのメッセージで、その可能性に言及していた。

シュナーベル氏はその中で「後任はEU首脳会議が指名する」と説明。「自分の退任後、自分の責務は必要に応じて役員会の残りメンバーに一時的に割り振られることになるだろう」と続けた。

item.title: 日米財務相が電話会談、ベッセント長官「強い円が望ましい」
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 片山さつき財務相は日本時間25日夜、ベッセント米財務長官と電話会談を行った。円の過小評価は問題だとの認識を再確認し、日米間の協力をさらに強化していくことをあらためて申し合わせたと、財務省が発表した。

ベッセント長官はその後、「日本の強固な経済ファンダメンタルズを反映した強い円が望ましい」との認識について協議したと、SNSの投稿で明らかにした。

この日は、日本の政策当局者から、政府の経済政策全般に対する市場の見方を意識した発言が相次いだ。円はここ数日、日本銀行の金融政策が円相場をどの程度支えられるかとの懸念が強まる中で下落していた。

ニューヨーク時間同日午前の外国為替市場では、日米財務相の会談が伝わると、円がドルに対して上げ幅を拡大。円は対ドルで一時、前日比1.2%高の1ドル＝156円94銭に上昇した。終盤の取引では157円台前半に上げを縮めている。

高市早苗首相は同日、現地時間22日にニューヨークで実施した日米首脳会談で、一般論として「円の過小評価は問題である」とトランプ米大統領に伝えたと、官邸で記者団に語っていた。会談ではトランプ氏から、円安によって米国の貿易が厳しいとの懸念を示され、回答したという。

ベッセント長官は今回の電話会談について、高市氏とトランプ氏の首脳会談を踏まえたもので、強固な日米関係を反映していると説明。為替市場について緊密な意思疎通を続ける重要性について協議したと述べた。

片山氏は同日午後に行ったブルームバーグのインタビューで、高市氏は金融緩和や財政拡張を志向する「リフレ派｣ではないと強調。日銀の独立性を尊重しているとも述べ、財政運営や金融政策への影響を巡る投資家の懸念を打ち消した。

円安傾向が続く為替市場では、過度に投機的な動きについて「断固たる措置を取る」とこれまでも表明しているとも発言。高市、トランプ両政権下では「行動をとることに躊躇（ちゅうちょ）しないとまで言っている」と話した。

item.title: 日米財務相が電話会談、円の過小評価は問題との認識を再確認－財務省

（ブルームバーグ）： 片山さつき財務相は日本時間25日夜、ベッセント米財務長官と電話会談を行い、円の過小評価は問題との認識を再確認した。財務省が文書で発表した。

それによると、両氏は金融市場の動向に関して意見交換を行い、日米間の協力をさらに強化していくこともあらためて確認した。

ニューヨーク時間同日午前の外国為替市場では、報道を受けて円がドルに対して上げ幅を拡大。円は対ドルで一時、前日比1.2%高の1ドル＝156円94銭を付けた。

高市早苗首相は同日、現地時間22日にニューヨークで実施した日米首脳会談で、一般論として「円の過小評価は問題である」とトランプ米大統領に伝えたと、官邸で記者団に語っていた。会談ではトランプ氏から、円安によって米国の貿易が厳しいとの懸念を示され、回答したという。

片山氏は同日午前の記者会見で、会談でトランプ氏から円安への懸念が示されたと発言。原油価格の高止まりや良好な米経済指標、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）による追加利上げ期待などからドル買いが優勢となる中、円は対ドルで上げ幅を拡大していた。

また、片山氏は同日午後にはブルームバーグのインタビューで、高市氏は金融緩和や財政拡張を志向する「リフレ派｣ではないと強調。日本銀行の独立性を尊重しているとも述べ、財政運営や金融政策への影響を巡る投資家の懸念を打ち消した。

円安傾向が続く為替市場では、過度に投機的な動きについて「断固たる措置を取る」とこれまでも表明しているとも発言。高市、トランプ両政権下では「行動をとることに躊躇（ちゅうちょ）しないとまで言っている」と話した。

item.description: BANGKOK, Sept 25 : Thailand's economy is expected to retain its momentum and grow by 2.5 per cent next year and could reach 3 per cent expansion within the next three years, the finance minister said on Friday, as the government pushes for new investments into key sectors. Ekniti Nitithanprapas told Reuter

Thai finance minister sees 2.5% growth next year on investment-led policies
